extraction.Name: Peter Bordeaux
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by Peter Bordeaux May 7, 1920
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold; Bordeaux mortgaged the land to W. R. McGeer for $500.00, mortgage due June 23, 1921; then on July 31, 1920, Bordeaux mortgaged the land to E. R. Musho for $300, due on demand; then on September 17, 1920, Bordeaux mortgaged the land to W. R. McGeer for $115.00, due June 23, 1921; Deed dated September 25, 1923, whereby Bordeaux and wife conveyed the land to W. H. Tackett for $2000, subject to the foregoing mortgages which Tackett assumes and agrees to pay
extraction.Buyer: W. H. Tackett for $2000, subject to foregoing mortgages which Tackett assumes and agrees to pay
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739598 issued; Northeast quarter section 12, township 37, north of range 26; receipt for patent signed April 3, 1920, by the allottee; first mortgage to W. R. McGeer for $500.00; second mortgage to E. R. Musho for $300; third mortgage to W. R. McGeer for $115.00
